sentences.text:
Shri Nilesh Manore - advocate for the petitioner/accu
 Shri Virendra Khadav - Public Prosecutor for the resp
 Order

The present M.Cr.C. is filed by the petitioner/accused under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. seeking quashment of FIR No.92/2023 registered at Police Station - Taal in SC No.11/2023 for the offence punishable under Section 363, 366, 344, 376(1), 376(2)n IPC and 5(L)/6, 5(J) (2)/6 POCSO Act.

Learned Public Prosecutor stated that after completing the investigation, investigating agency filed charge-sheet and the matter committed to the Sessions Court and Sessions Court registered as SC No.11/2023 and further stated that PW/1 was examined.

While hearing the matter, learned counsel for the petitioner/accused seeks permission to withdraw the application with liberty to raise all the objections before trial Court, which were taken before this Court.
The submission made by learned counsel for the petitioner/accused is recorded.
Accordingly, application is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
(DUPPALA VENKATA RAMANA) JUDGE Aiyer Sonu @ Chainsingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110719466/
